name: Dragon Utopia Rework
description: With this submod Tome of Air Magic and Spellbinder’s Hat can be obtained only from size 3 and 4 Dragon Utopia. Moreover, chances for respective Utopia sizes are changed – 15% for minimum size, 35% for size 2 and, 35% for size 3 and 15% for maximum size.
author: wnukos
